skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The clothes Vina wore when inspiring her people to take back their homeland.
Victoria. She uses her own name to urge them forwards, and her homeland's name to guide herself true.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Her war never ended.
Dark clouds gather once more above Londinium's walls, but thankfully, Vina Victoria is not alone.

skins.name: Glorious Path
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection/Glorious Path. Ceremonial clothes worn by Vina Victoria. The natural combination of black and white is contrasted with golden ornamentation, granting the wearer majesty and unbridled charm.
skins.usage: One of Vina Victoria's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Atop the stairs, her figure, sword in hand, is as pure and dazzling as the morning light.
